The '''Lorenz system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Pelagia Province]], situated along the [[Calipsa Run]]. It was annexed into [[Calipsa Province]] with the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].
